# Missing-baseline recovery: coverage and ClonoGate paired comparison (auto-generated by scripts/merge_recovered_baselines.py)

ClonoGate is `partition_v3`. The "before" table is the preregistered analysis re-run on the original baseline scores; the script asserts that it reproduces `reports/v3_holdout_ANALYSIS.json` (the numbers in the report) before anything else is computed. The "after" table is the same analysis with recovered runs filling designs where the original baseline had no score. This is a post-hoc update of baseline coverage; the preregistered holdout result is the "before" table. Scores are the official SMC-Het scorer, unmodified. Recovered CCube and PhylogicNDT runs use the original command lines with longer wall-clock caps (CCube 6 h, PhylogicNDT 10 h). Recovered FastClone assigns the 1-4 mutations per design whose posterior row is undefined to the largest cluster. The bracket-fixed PhylogicNDT is a separate variant that widens only a missing Stirling root bracket.
